verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships an official first-party CLI (`llama cli`, `llama serve`) documented directly in the repo for running, serving, and even multimodal/VLM sessions, and community reports confirm hands-on use of these CLI tools (e.g., llama-mtmd-cli for vision). Missing for 10: dedicated CLI reference docs/man pages and independent commentary specifically framing the CLI as built for agentic/automated workflows.
